content:
# Protagonist Gender and Pronouns

Use the selected protagonist's recorded gender and pronouns consistently. These are authoring preferences, not a topic to introduce into the story unless the player does.
name: Protagonist Gender and Pronouns

generation.prompt: A thoughtful game master at a parchment-covered table carefully reviews a character folio, one hand resting beside a neat row of character portraits and small identity markers, conveying attentive, respectful authorship without making gender or pronouns a story spectacle. Compose as a polished tabletop RPG guide cover: the GM in the foreground, warmly focused, with a few players and softly suggested fantasy character sketches in the background. Clear, balanced shapes and expressive poses; crisp black outlines, simple forms, flat cell-shading, restrained palette of parchment cream, deep teal, rust red, and muted gold, minimal texture. Franco-Belgian bande dessinée Ligne Claire illustration, welcoming and considerate mood, no text, no labels, no watermarks.
